text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Severity P1 - GPU attach failures in gcp-us-west1 impacting inference autoscale. Symptoms: queue growth, attach_denied from cloud provider, fallback requests failing. Links: https://internal.ops/dashboard/queues?region=us-west1 , runbook: https://runbooks.internal/gpu-quota

Jordan (oncall): Acked. Seeing spike in endpoint queue length ~3x baseline. Taking oncall.

Mike (infra): Confirmed autoscaler logs show repeated attach errors:
```
ERROR: attach_volume: Attach for instance failed: googleapi: Error 403: Quota exceeded for field 'GPUS'
kube-controller-manager: unable to attach instances, retrying
```

Sara (eng-sre): Also seeing the inference p99 latency jump from 120ms -> 1.8s for hosted endpoints in us-west1. Customer error rate up ~6%. Dashboard: https://internal.metrics/infra/latency?env=prod

Jordan (oncall): Quick mitigation plan: 1) Pause new rollout traffic to us-west1 2) Reroute a portion of traffic to us-central1 3) Enable CPU fallback variant for non-critical routes 4) Open support request with GCP for quota increase. I'll run traffic split now.

ops-bot: ran command: `rb route set-split --from=us-west1 --to=us-central1 --percent=30 --force`

Jordan (oncall): Done. 30% moved. Monitoring queue.

Mike (infra): We can also reduce gpu_per_pod on the hot pool to allow more pods to schedule onto existing GPUs. Patch suggestion: change gpu.request from 1 -> 0.5 on the model-slim profile; will require quick validation.

Sara (eng-sre): Pushing CPU fallback for chat-stream route now (gpt-medium-cpu). This will degrade output quality slightly but keeps customers alive. Deployed with canary.

Alex (customer-success): Rolling status update drafted for status.redwood.ai: "Degraded inference performance in us-west1 due to cloud GPU quota limits; partial traffic rerouted and CPU fallback enabled. Working on quota remediation." Will post in 10m unless we improve.

Mike (infra): Opened GCP support ticket #INC-98762 and requested emergency quota bump. Also submitted region expansion request for us-west2 as contingency.

Jordan (oncall): Quick log snippet showing attach denied:
```
I0323 21:08:12.345 kubelet.go:345] Failed to attach accelerator: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = googleapi: Error 403: Quota exceeded for quota metric 'NVIDIA_K80_GPUS' and limit 'NVIDIA_K80_GPUS_PER_PROJECT', resource: projects/rdw-prod
```

ops-bot: Suggestion: apply temporary scale-down policy to background batch jobs to free GPUs: `rb autoscale patch -p batch-workers --max=2`

Jordan (oncall): Applying scale-down to non-critical batch pools.

Sara (eng-sre): After reroute + CPU fallback + batch scale-down: queue growth slowed, p99 latency improved to ~650ms but still above baseline. Customer error rate back to ~1.8%.

Alex (customer-success): Posted initial status update and tagged top 20 customers with high traffic. Responses: two customers acknowledged, one asked for ETA.

Mike (infra): ETA from GCP support prelim: next 4-6 hours for quota review, emergency window possible but not guaranteed.

Jordan (oncall): Since this is spanning shift change, handing off to Lina (oncall) in 20m. Lina — summary: cause = project GPU quota exhausted in us-west1; mitigations in flight = 30% traffic reroute to us-central1, CPU fallback enabled, batch pools scaled down, GCP ticket opened. Next steps: monitor ticket, consider cross-region failover beyond 30% if queue rebounds, keep CS updated.

Lina (oncall): Ack - taking over. I'll keep the bridge open and escalate with Mike if we see requeueing above threshold (queue > 2k). Also will prepare a temporary rule to divert additional 20% if needed.

Jordan (oncall): Handing off docs: https://incidents.internal/4389991234/notes — include logs and commands I ran. :white_check_mark:

Lina (oncall): Thanks. I'll update last_message_ts when resolved or when further escalation happens. :rotating_light:
